notes.title: Minor updates
notes.content:
Just some minor fixes and edits.
Well, one fairly large fix, but then some minor ones.

notes.title: VR-3KKR
notes.content:
Happy new year!
VR-3KKR addon added on. 8 challenge maps + one secret map. Also new deathmatch arenas.
Small changes no one will notice. DSSECRET sound.
Map fixes. Unless something is horribly broken I'm hoping this is the last update for I-dunno-2-years-maybe.

Win32 support (if I did it right, we'll see), but also maybe broken saves on E1M4 and E3M3. The others shouldn't break, I don't think (as they weren't altered).
Fixed some typos, some internal stuff that 99.9% of people won't notice...

Various fixes and such.
There's a fancy wad called REKBONUS by brightentayle that is autoloaded when dropped in the REKKR Sunken Land folder, you can find it discussed here: https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/90862-rekkr-v116/?page=24
Short of it is: Adds the bonus ep from the original mod release as an episode 5. Needs to be named "REKBONUS.wad" or it won't work.

Fixed softlocks and made the flame monster faster, to be a bit deadlier.
As an aside I've been calling them Djinn, so. There's that, if you need a name for them.
E4M7 will break saves. I think that's the only map that will.

Fixed softlocks on E4M2 and E4M5.
This will break saves on those maps (sorry about that).
Other saves should be unaffected.

notes.title: 10/12/2021 update
notes.content:
Edited for extra source port compatibility.
Saves [i]shouldn't [/i]break. Shouldn't. The ones I tested didn't.
Some new menu options (turn off/on autsaving, and some automap options, resizable statusbar)
